subject: Demo: Redwood Inference walkthrough with Zenith IO — scheduling & timezone rotation
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Tan <sam.tan@zenith.io>, Lucy Chen <lucy.chen@zenith.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference walkthrough with Zenith IO — scheduling & timezone rotation

Hi Sam / Lucy,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to show a focused run through of how Redwood can help Zenith IO reduce inference costs and stabilize tail latency for your customer-facing features. To make the session most valuable we want the following people on the call:
- AE (me) for commercial / rollout discussion
- SE (Camila) for an architecture + live demo
- Your engineers (platform + app) and whoever from procurement/security who will own the contract and technical review

I know coordinating across US/EU/APAC can be painful — instead of one awkward time we'll propose a rotating set of 60-minute demo slots so stakeholders in each region can see the same material at reasonable hours. Attached is a short pre-demo checklist and a proposed rotation matrix.

Proposed candidate slots (all durations 60m):
1) Slot A — US morning / EU afternoon overlap: 2026-11-18 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET
2) Slot B — EU morning / APAC evening overlap: 2026-11-19 10:30 CET / 18:30 SGT
3) Slot C — APAC morning / US late overlap (follow-on): 2026-11-20 08:30 SGT / 17:30 PT (same day US)

Can you confirm which slot(s) work for your team and who from procurement/security should be invited? If none of these fit, list 2–3 windows and we’ll re-run the matrix.

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference
Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf
From: Lucy Chen <lucy.chen@zenith.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Tan <sam.tan@zenith.io>, procurement@zenith.io, security.ops@zenith.io
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:41:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference walkthrough with Zenith IO — scheduling & timezone rotation

Diego — thanks for the clear plan. A few notes from our side:
- Procurement needs a procurement lead on the invite: Elena Morris (elena.morris@zenith.io). They prefer demos in their local business hours (09:00–17:00 CET) unless it’s a short technical deep-dive.
- Security will want a 15-minute Q&A at the end; they’ve asked for a short list of where logs live and data retention defaults ahead of time.
- Our core infra engineers (Sam is coordinating) are available for Slot A and Slot B but have conflicts for Slot C. APAC product leads are only available late on 11/19 (after 18:00 SGT) rather than early 11/20.

Given that, we suggest:
- Run Slot A for EU/US stakeholders
- Run Slot B as the primary APAC-oriented slot but push it 30 minutes later to 19:00 SGT if possible (that helps our product people attend)

I’ve attached a summary of our constraints. Also — do you have a short technical note on log retention and audit trails you can share before the session? Security wants to triage the risk questions prior to the live demo.

--
Lucy Chen
Head of Platform Integrations | Zenith IO
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Chen <lucy.chen@zenith.io>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sam Tan <sam.tan@zenith.io>, elena.morris@zenith.io, security.ops@zenith.io
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference walkthrough with Zenith IO — scheduling & timezone rotation

Hi Lucy / team — happy to push a short technical doc ahead of the demo. Attaching a one-pager that covers:
- audit log locations (console + S3 buckets for private deployments)
- retention defaults and configurable policies
- customer-managed KMS options and key rotation cadence

Operationally, for the live demo I recommend the following runbook so the same content can be recycled across slots without heavy prep each time:
- 0–10m: Quick intro + success metrics from Zenith (AE)
- 10–35m: Live demo of inference pipeline + performance profile (SE)
- 35–50m: Integration & deployment options (SE + Eng)
- 50–60m: Security/procurement Q&A and next steps

If we lock to two slots (A and B), we can prepare one recording to send the third region and avoid duplicating heavier logistics. I also sketched a tri-shift matrix in the Drive doc (link below).

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: tech-reqs.md
Related: https://docs.google.com/document/d/tri-shift-plan

Thanks for the quick responses — good constraints to bake in. To confirm next steps:
- We'll schedule two live 60m sessions and offer a recording for the third region. Proposed final schedule (please pick preferred option):
  Option 1:
    • Slot A: 2026-11-18 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET — Focus: EU/US (recording available)
    • Slot B: 2026-11-19 11:00 CET / 19:00 SGT — Focus: APAC/EMEA (moved 30m later per request)
  Option 2:
    • Slot A: 2026-11-18 09:30 PT / 17:30 CET
    • Slot B: 2026-11-19 10:30 CET / 18:30 SGT

- Camila will send the technical one-pager and we’ll include a 15-minute dedicated security block.
- I’ll create calendar invites and a single HubSpot activity linked to ZEN-4821.

Please reply with either "Confirm Option 1", "Confirm Option 2", or provide one alternate window. Once we have a slot we’ll lock invites (and I’ll add Elena & security.ops).

Calendar proposal: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=demo-slot-proposal

Best,

Diego
